body: SUPPLEMENTAL PROVIDER EVIDENCE FOR ITEM 2. At current storymodel4s main, ModelStatus has Draft, Validated, and Adjudicated phantom states. StoryModelCodec.modelEncoder accepts StoryModel[S] for any ModelStatus; status is deliberately absent from the wire; decode always yields StoryModel[Draft]. StoryModelCodecSuite asserts encode(draft) == encode(validated) and identical checksums across all three statuses. Therefore the draft does not face a codec or canonical-form obstacle to carrying optional canonical StoryModelCodec bytes on a Partial result. The unresolved question is a scientific publication policy: whether the partial graph is coherent enough to preserve as a draft artifact, with gaps and validation failure held in the result/receipt. If policy forbids it, that must be explicit and generic payloads must not smuggle a parallel graph. Evidence: story/model.scala:8-12; codec/story.scala:24-26,611-662; StoryModelCodecSuite.scala:48-56. No API-name or implementation ruling implied.
